map.农机油耗估算（亩耗油） 使用指南: Farm-machinery fuel consumption estimator (per-mu fuel) user guide
map.输入作业面积、总耗油量，计算亩耗油与燃油成本；可填作业时长和油价进一步估算: Input operation area and total fuel to compute per-mu fuel and fuel cost; optionally fill operation time and fuel price for further estimation
map.亩耗油 = 总耗油量 ÷ 作业面积；每小时油耗 = 总耗油 ÷ 作业时长；作业效: Per-mu fuel = total fuel used / operation area; hourly fuel = total fuel / operation time; operation efficiency = area / time; fuel cost = total fuel x fuel price
map.以实际总耗油与作业面积直接折算亩耗油（L/亩），是农机经济性的核心指标。填写作业: Directly convert per-mu fuel (L/mu) from actual total fuel and operation area, a core indicator of farm-machinery economy. Filling operation time also gives hourly fuel and efficiency; filling fuel price gives total fuel cost and per-mu fuel cost, aiding farm-machinery pricing and cost comparison.
map.油耗 = 作业面积 × 亩耗油系数（L/亩）。: Fuel use = operation area x per-mu fuel coefficient (L/mu).
map.按作业类型（耕/播/收）分别取系数。: Take coefficients by operation type (till/sow/harvest) separately.
map.用于作业成本与燃油补贴核算。: For operation cost and fuel-subsidy accounting.
: wheat machine-harvest per-mu fuel about 1.2 L/mu; 500 mu -> fuel = 500 x 1.2 = 600 L. At fuel price 7.5 yuan/L, fuel cost 4500 yuan, 12.5% of machine-harvest fee (about 60 yuan/mu).

map.为什么不同作业亩耗油差很多？: Why does per-mu fuel differ so much between operations?
map.耕深、阻力、车速决定负荷。深松/旋耕最费油，运输较轻。同一机型负荷越大单位油耗越: Tillage depth, resistance and vehicle speed determine load. Deep loosening/rotary tillage uses the most fuel; transport is lighter. Same model at higher load has higher per-unit fuel but also higher efficiency; look at "per mu" not "per hour".
map.保持机具锐利、胎压正常、档位转速匹配（避免大油门低速）、合理规划减少空驶。定期保: Keep tools sharp, tire pressure normal, gear/engine-speed matched (avoid high throttle at low speed), and plan to reduce empty runs. Regular maintenance saves more fuel than switching to bigger horsepower.
